payload.invalid-examples.json of https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/backup/initiate-import/1.0: (1) Missing both pre-commitments. A slot opened without a digest accepts whatever arrives, which is exactly the property that makes a leaked write token harmless when they are present. (2) Uppercase hex digest. Caught by the pattern before a slot is opened. (4) Zero `expectedSizeBytes`. There is nothing to import, and a slot sized for no bytes would accept an empty upload as a successful transfer. (5)

A list never returns credential bodies, so a member asking for them must not silently be ignored. (2) status outside the derived enum. `suspended` is not a state this task computes, and admitting it would let a consumer filter on something no agent can answer. (3) holder that is not a DID. (4) pageSize of zero. A page of nothing is not a page, and minimum: 1 refuses the shape that would otherwise loop a consumer forever. (5) Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be rev
